name: obsidian_list_notes
description: List notes and subdirectories at a vault path. Defaults to the vault root when `path` is omitted. Tune recursion with `depth`, or filter the walk with `extension` / `nameRegex`. Capped at 1000 entries per call — when reached, walking stops and `excluded` is set; narrow `path` or tighten filters to surface the rest.

depth.description: How many directory levels to walk. `1` = target directory only (no recursion); `2` = target plus its immediate children — a structural overview; bump higher to drill in. Prefer narrowing `path` to a subdirectory over a high `depth` on the vault root.

extension.description: Only include files matching this extension, with or without leading dot. Applies to files only — directories are returned regardless.

nameRegex.description: Optional ECMAScript regex (no flags, ≤256 chars, no nested quantifiers like `(a+)+`) applied to entry names. Matches both files and directories; directories that fail the regex are skipped without recursing into them.

path.description: Vault-relative directory path. Omit for the vault root.
